pilot_reason: Requested first pilot; direct UVLIN/IMAGR history and prior background support across all 16 declared splits. No gravity residual used.

selection.boundary: Zero extension; exclude the full square kernel radius at image edges. Do not renormalize edges.
selection.units: Unit-sum angular convolution preserves Jy per native restoring beam. Both signal and sigma use this unit, so the threshold equals one expressed per target beam.
selection.sigma: Per-channel Gaussian-scaled MAD from fixed western MOM0-screened annulus; subtract its per-channel median before detection. This fully declared nuisance estimator need not equal the undocumented publisher estimator.
selection.mask: Union of all qualifying runs of at least three consecutive native stored channels; no wrap, dilation, or hand editing. Missing/nonfinite voxels fail closed. This is a conditional reconstruction, not the publisher master mask.

support.rule: Finite positive released MOM0 support expanded by 120 arcsec is excluded. Calibration west, validation east of the fixed guard. Injection patches must avoid expanded support, image convolution edges and western calibration. Centers lie in the validation annulus and are chosen evenly from row-major eligible lattice positions before opening cube pixels.
support.caveat: Same-observation MOM0 screening is selection-dependent; nondetection is not absence of HI. No support is certified pure or line-free.

response_contract: Integrate an intrinsic Gaussian over pre-Hanning cells, apply the declared [1/4,1/2,1/4] filter where applicable and retain every channel or alternate channels, then apply the history-bound image-domain UVLIN surrogate A. The decimated pre-grid spacing is half the stored spacing. These brackets are not an exact measured correlator response; the archived header does not identify the online taper/decimation. No branch is selected using observed outcomes.
spatial_response: Elliptical Gaussian restoring beam from AIPS CLEAN history, with north-through-east position angle and signed FITS angular axes. Additional Gaussian covariance equals circular 30-arcsec covariance minus restoring-beam covariance. This models restored emission, not nonlinear CLEAN, dirty sidelobes, primary-beam correction or missing spacings.
noise_contract: Empirical trials add known restored signals to fixed real native background patches. Separately, 32 stationary Gaussian realizations per spectral branch filter independent spatial pixels by the same restoring Gaussian, propagate spectral covariance as A H H-transpose A-transpose, and apply the detection convolution. One scalar calibrates the average detector marginal variance to the observed western MAD. This Gaussian spatial covariance is a sensitivity surrogate, not an inferred interferometric covariance.

injections.amplitude_definition: Scale the pre-continuum detector peak to amplitude times the western median MAD across channels. Record post-continuum signed flux separately from positive pre-continuum source flux.
metrics: known pre-continuum native source flux retained
paired selected-flux difference versus uninjected baseline
injections.interpretation: Positions, cases and paired branches are dependent. Empirical position fractions are descriptive, not completeness estimates. Simulated standard errors are conditional Monte Carlo error only.

previous_exposure: Development-exposed galaxy, prior background and spectral diagnostics; not prospective galaxy holdout or retrospective preregistration. Config is frozen before the new selection and injection results.
